description: CDASH CMDOSFRQ (C78419) -- Concomitant Medication Dosing Frequency per Interval. All 8 official CDISC submission values included, plus 1 sponsor extension (weekly / QW) that Precision actively uses but which is not in the official C78419 subset. The codelist is CDISC-marked extensible, so adding this is standard practice, not a deviation. See is_extension flag per choice. 2026-10-04: restored other (sponsor extension on an extensible CDISC codelist). The earlier version dropped the existing 'Other' option from both BioIVT studies and orphaned the 'Other, specify' field.
source: NCI EVS CDISC CDASH Controlled Terminology, CMDOSFRQ C78419, fetched 2026-09-28 from https://evs.nci.nih.gov/ftp1/CDISC/SDTM/CDASH%20Terminology.pdf
